permeabilityMd.selected: Table A1 field column; 0.256 D in published equation

wellRadiusFt.selected: Converted to 0.0890016 m; paper SI column rounds to 0.089002 m

formationPressurePsi.selected: Field column retained; paired 17656 kPa is rounded

fracturingReferencePsi.selected: Published comparison reference only; never an operating, safe or permitted limit

rateRangeBblPerDay.selected: Table A1 bpd range; interpreted as reservoir volume because equation q is m3/s; no stock-tank inference

pairedUnitDecisions: Use Table A1 field-side values and explicit conversions, avoiding mixed rounded columns.
The 256 mD and 2.5e-13 m2 pair is rounded; retain 0.256 D and the literal published 2e-6 coefficient.
The coefficient approximates 1 D as 1e-12 m2; exact Darcy conversion is 9.869233e-13 m2. Exact-SI pressure differences would be about 1.325% larger; they are not silently substituted.
Rate conversion uses 0.158987294928 m3/bbl and 86400 s/day; paired 318–1590 m3/day values are rounded.
Pressure is reported psi with absolute/gauge basis unspecified; all pressures share the formation datum. Pressure differences cancel a common offset.
Reject inconsistent oil density pair 7.18 lbm/ft3 versus 860 kg/m3; neither is used.
Do not use the inconsistent depth pair 5914 ft versus 1797 m; depth and wellhead conversion are outside this example.

assumptions.completion: The full published 15 ft formation thickness is assumed to be the contributing injection interval h; no partial-penetration correction is applied.
assumptions.scope: Steady radial homogeneous single-phase water flow with fixed formation pressure and viscosity; externally selected constant skin, no oil-invasion or time evolution.
assumptions.volumeBasis: Reservoir volumetric rate; no B_w or stock-tank conversion is applied.
